title: 2.4 Unit Conversion
description: Unit Conversion concepts and applications. Hard level, 20 questions.

questions.question: A car travels 90 km in 15 minutes. What is its speed in km/h?
Convert 36 km/h into meters per second.
Convert 120 km/h into meters per second.
A beam-balance pan holds 1.5 kg, 500 g, 250 g, 25 g and 0.8 g. What is the total mass in grams?
A beam-balance pan holds 3 kg, 900 g, 90 g and 5 g. What mass balances it in grams?
Express the Sun-Earth distance $1.5\times10^{11}$ m using a prefix.
The volume of Earth is about $10^{21}$ cubic meters. What is this in cubic kilometers?
The volume of Earth is about $10^{21}$ cubic meters. What is this in cubic centimeters?
A tank holds 2.5 tonnes of water. How many kilograms is that?
A rope of 6 m and a ruler of 50 cm are used to measure a plot. How many ruler lengths equal one stick length?
A distance is $2.0\times10^{-3}$ of a meter. Which prefix expression matches it?
A particle has diameter 10 nm. What is that in micrometers?
A timer reads 3 minutes and 20 seconds. What is that in seconds?
A runner covers 1.5 km in 5 minutes. What is the speed in meters per second?
A mass of 0.8 quintal is expressed in grams. What is the value?
Which single expression equals 3 hours plus 10 minutes plus 2 minutes?
A student converts 6.7 hours to minutes and gets 402. Which check confirms the result?
options: 6 hours gives 360 minutes and 0.7 hour gives 42 minutes now
6 hours gives 60 minutes and 0.7 hour gives 7 minutes still
6.7 minutes gives 402 seconds in this topic in the textbook
6.7 hours gives 67 minutes now for students in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: 6 hours gives 360 minutes and 0.7 hour gives 42 minutes now
